events.title: Beeple NFT sells for $69 million at Christie's
events.summary: Christie's closed the sale of Beeple's "Everydays: The First 5000 Days" on March 11, 2021 for $69.3 million — the highest-priced NFT by a living artist at the time.
events.about: The ERC-721 token bundled 5,000 daily digital images into one on-chain collectible bought with ether. Mainstream art houses, celebrities, and startups rushed into NFTs — minting PFP projects, music rights, and gaming assets until the 2022 crash cooled speculation.

narrative.whyChosen: Beeple's Christie's sale put NFTs on front pages worldwide.
narrative.whyImportant: It proved digital art could command eight-figure prices with blockchain provenance.
narrative.problemSolved: Digital creators lacked scarcity and resale royalties in a copy-paste internet.
